blind_read: Seated gamer loses, throws controller into television and slumps.

evidence.observation: Both hands enclose the light gamepad below the dark headset. The green TV field changes to a distinctly shaped red X.
The pad leaves the extended palms, crosses the screen edge, and ends on the ground between the lowered hands and the TV. Hardware colors hold in teal.

inspection: Inspected the decoded GIF exposures at native size, fur variants on cream and charcoal, and magnified drawings. Timing reconstructed from exposure durations; examined runtime hold/repeat and reduced-pose definitions.
